title.narrative: Supporting Local Authorities for accountable, responsive and transparent systems for solid waste management

description.narrative: The overall objective of this Action is to improve the governance of Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) to enable effective delivery of public services around solid waste management (SWM) that facilitates inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable urban settlements. Specifically, the Action will target three ULBs in Bihars Patna district and will build the capacities of the ULBs in decentralised governance and strengthen their technical expertise in effective SWM; develop a robust, sustainable and environmentally viable model for effective SWM in urban and peri-urban areas; and, promote citizen engagement in planning and public monitoring of SWM to improve transparency, accountability and responsiveness of ULBs.
